## Works

<div id="orcid-publications">
  <p>Loading publications from <a href="https://orcid.org/0009-0000-7576-5380">ORCID</a>…</p>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  const orcid = "0009-0000-7576-5380";
  const target = document.getElementById("orcid-publications");
  const endpoint = `https://pub.orcid.org/v3.0/${orcid}/works`;

  const valueAt = (object, path) =>
    path.reduce((value, key) => value?.[key], object)?.value ?? "";

  const escapeHtml = (text) => String(text ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (char) => ({
    "&": "&amp;",
    "<": "&lt;",
    ">": "&gt;",
    '"': "&quot;",
    "'": "&#39;"
  }[char]));

  const workDate = (work) => {
    const date = work["publication-date"] ?? {};
    return ["year", "month", "day"]
      .map((part) => date[part]?.value)
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join("-");
  };

  const doiFor = (work) => {
    const ids = work["external-ids"]?.["external-id"] ?? [];
    const doi = ids.find((id) => id["external-id-type"] === "doi");
    return doi?.["external-id-normalized"]?.value ?? doi?.["external-id-value"];
  };

  const safeUrl = (url) => {
    try {
      const parsed = new URL(url);
      return parsed.protocol === "https:" ? parsed.href : `https://orcid.org/${orcid}`;
    } catch {
      return `https://orcid.org/${orcid}`;
    }
  };

  const workUrl = (work) => {
    const url = work.url?.value;
    const doi = doiFor(work);
    if (url) return safeUrl(url);
    if (doi) return safeUrl(`https://doi.org/${doi}`);
    return `https://orcid.org/${orcid}`;
  };

  const authorsFor = (work) => {
    const contributors = work.contributors?.contributor ?? [];
    return contributors
      .map((contributor) => ({
        name: contributor["credit-name"]?.value?.trim(),
        orcid: contributor["contributor-orcid"]?.path
      }))
      .filter((contributor) => contributor.name)
      .map((contributor) => {
        const name = escapeHtml(contributor.name);
        return contributor.orcid === orcid ? `<strong>${name}</strong>` : name;
      })
      .join(", ");
  };

  const fetchJson = (url) =>
    fetch(url, { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } }).then((response) => {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`ORCID returned ${response.status}`);
      return response.json();
    });

  fetchJson(endpoint)
    .then((data) => {
      const summaries = (data.group ?? [])
        .map((group) => group["work-summary"]?.[0])
        .filter(Boolean);

      return Promise.all(summaries.map((summary) => {
        const detailUrl = `https://pub.orcid.org/v3.0/${orcid}/work/${summary["put-code"]}`;
        return fetchJson(detailUrl).catch(() => summary);
      }));
    })
    .then((works) => {
      works.sort((a, b) => workDate(b).localeCompare(workDate(a)));

      if (works.length === 0) {
        target.innerHTML = `<p>No public ORCID works found.</p>`;
        return;
      }

      const items = works.map((work) => {
        const authors = authorsFor(work);
        const title = escapeHtml(valueAt(work, ["title", "title"]));
        const date = escapeHtml(valueAt(work, ["publication-date", "year"]));
        const venue = escapeHtml(valueAt(work, ["journal-title"]));
        const type = escapeHtml((work.type ?? "").replaceAll("-", " "));
        const link = escapeHtml(workUrl(work));

        const typeNote = type && type !== "journal article" ? ` [${type}]` : "";

        return `<li>
          <a href="${link}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${title}</a>${date ? ` (${date})` : ""}${typeNote}.${venue ? ` <em>${venue}</em>.` : ""}${authors ? ` by ${authors}.` : ""}
        </li>`;
      }).join("");

      target.innerHTML = `<ul>${items}</ul>
        <p><small>Automatically loaded from <a href="https://orcid.org/${orcid}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ORCID</a>.</small></p>`;
    })
    .catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      target.innerHTML = `<p>Could not load publications automatically. See my <a href="https://orcid.org/${orcid}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ORCID profile</a>.</p>`;
    });
})();
</script>
